files.summary: End-to-end acceptance tests for FR-1..FR-9 via in-process ApiHost

note: Proposed tests (12 [Fact] method(s)). Executed only by the orchestrator's sandbox run. Trimmed to a single file with 12 [Fact] methods to meet the limit. Per-IP isolation is simulated with the X-Client-Id header, which the developer's GetClientId uses for rate limiting. Tests assume the rate limiter uses the injected FakeTimeProvider. FR-5 and FR-6 'unknown code 404' are checked inside Redirect_and_metadata_behaviour and Analytics_counts_successful_redirects_only. The 1000-parallel-redirect NFR and the coverage check are not included because of the fact limit.
